backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features with associated files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides high-level descriptions of key frontend files including App, styles, Tailwind config, and content data.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app with the updated Study Vibe title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React SPA with language toggle, navigation, subject cards, and branding assets.
frontend/src/content/class9Summaries.ts: Exports bilingual Class 9 subject summaries with titles, content, images, and alt text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor instance based on the user's identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state and Internet Identity login/logout handling through a React context.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base layers and defines light/dark OKLCH design tokens and utility styles including scrollbar hiding.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the Internet Identity provider and mounts the App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s feature set, versions, and objectives including renaming to Study Vibe and adding images and Hindi translations.
